title: Listen to Billy Joel's First-Ever Live Call-In Show on SiriusXM
summary: Fans can call Billy Joel live and submit questions by video, voice, or text ahead of the September 24 special.
body_markdown:
[Billy Joel](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-billy-joel-channel) is taking your questions during his live call-in special, *Ask Billy* , on SiriusXM.


The Piano Man sits down at the piano for a special live broadcast, taking calls from fans and responding to questions submitted by video, voice memo, or text.


[The Billy Joel Channel Exclusively on SiriusXM Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAskBillyJoel)


During the inaugural special, Billy connected directly with listeners and answered their questions while sharing stories and music from throughout his legendary career.


The music icon also offered fans an update on his health.


“I just want people to know, don’t worry about me, I’m not going anywhere,” Billy said. “I’m here. I’m still here.”


### *Ask Billy* : How to Participate


Fans can call **844-365-BILLY** during the live show for a chance to speak directly with Billy.


You can also start submitting questions now by video, voice memo, or text at[siriusxm.com/askbilly](https://www.siriusxm.com/askbilly) .
